content: Search at few-thousand-records scale: plain LIKE/ILIKE sequential scan is millisecond-fast and sufficient; SQLite FTS5 beats Postgres FTS in raw speed at small scale (connection overhead dominates); Postgres tsvector+GIN is the natural upgrade when already on Postgres (stemming, ranking, websearch_to_tsquery). External engines (Elasticsearch/Meilisearch/Typesense) unjustified below ~100k records or until typo-tolerance is needed.
